verdicts.why: In Destined, Kamala pulls the fire alarm as Najma walks into the wedding party and fights the Clandestines; Damage Control then arrests the Clandestines, so she is not saving the party from Damage Control.
The 1942 scenes are Aisha's own story; Kamala arrives in the 1947 train yard, finds the dying Aisha, and helps Sana get back to her father.
Wikipedia's ep 8 summary: a living Agatha helps Billy find Tommy's soul and Billy puts it into a drowning boy's body. In ep 9 ghost Agatha and Billy set out to find Tommy.

In Eye Spy, Akela's controller is an unknown handler (the Englishman), who is himself controlled by someone else. The Clairvoyant is not tied to her in this episode, so naming him spoils later episodes.
The Eye Spy plot calls her controller an unknown second person or handler. Fitz and Simmons remove the kill switch implant, and nothing in the episode links her to the Clairvoyant.
Same as above: in S1#4 she is run by an unidentified handler through her bionic eye. The Clairvoyant connection comes later.
Akela tells May she must kill her or her handler will kill her, and Coulson sedates her before she can. The handler is unnamed in this episode.
Coulson trained Akela and frees her by rerouting the eye feed and having the kill switch removed. The controller is an unknown handler, not the Clairvoyant, in S1#4.

Alexandra confronts Danny at Midland Circle and sends Elektra to capture him in Worst Behavior (#3), and Elektra kills her in Ashes, Ashes (#6), so a stage at #7 begins after her death. The dragon bones are only revealed in #8.
In WM108, Trevor returns as the Mandarin on live TV to cover up the set's destruction, and Cleary leads the Damage Control agents who arrest him and sends him to a high security prison.
In DDBA203, the AVTF officer Saunders tells Daredevil and Karen that Fisk is wrong, hands over his Red Hook keycard, and says 'You've got to stop Fisk'. Fandom lists Fisk among his enemies.
Cassandra leaves Wade and Logan to be consumed by Alioth but they escape. Alioth returns during the Resistance assault and they escape again. Logan never helps take it down.

The Journey Into Mystery plot has no solo enchantment attempt. Loki runs sideways as a distraction, which fails, and Classic Loki's illusion of Asgard draws Alioth off so Loki and Sylvie can enchant it and reach the Citadel.
Mobius arrives in a pizza delivery car to pick Sylvie up as she flees Alioth, turns toward the beast at her urging, and later goes back to the TVA through a timedoor before the enchantment.
Hogarth meets Alisa at the Eastern Regional Detention Center and offers the deal that keeps her out of the Raft, cited JJ210 (S2#10).

Mack draws on Luther Banks until Banks gets a call from Price and leaves without Daisy, while Mack and Daisy are retrieving Lincoln (AoS303). Coulson's deal to advise Price also comes in that episode.
Mack and Coulson intercept Sousa after his delivery, I.C.E.R. him, fake his death and bring him to Zephyr One in Out of the Past, cited AoS704.
After the defeat of Eli Morrow, Rodriguez and Mackenzie finally let their feelings blossom and kiss at the Playground (AoS408).
Grill implants their metrics, puts them to work, and pins them to the wall during the Renewal, offering them to Holt, all cited AoS502. Grill dies in AoS506.

In The Singularity, Mack is in Bucharest with Fitz and Simmons to find Radcliffe. When the comms are jammed he goes to the club and is confronted by Hellfire, who came with Hive and Daisy to kidnap Radcliffe.

Radcliffe's deception is uncovered by S4#10 and 11, Mack questions his LMD in Hot Potato Soup (S4#12), and Mack is captured and replaced before S4#15, so 'ally' from S4#15 is wrong. The consultant period, when Mack distrusts Aida, is earlier in S4.
Mack interrogates the Radcliffe LMD with Fitz and Simmons to find the real Radcliffe in Hot Potato Soup (S4#12), after Radcliffe's plot with Aida and the May LMD is exposed.

The transitioner request comes in AoS301, at the hospital, before Lincoln works with S.H.I.E.L.D. In Closure (AoS309), Mack assembles a team with Lincoln and Joey to go after Hydra, which has kidnapped Fitz and Simmons.
In AoS213 Simmons briefs Garner on Skye's medical situation, and he overrules her sedative suggestion and keeps working with Skye.
At S3#20 Lash goes to Hive in Lincoln's place under Lincoln's own plan, so 'enemy' from there is wrong. Lincoln learns Garner is Lash in Chaos Theory (S3#7), where he confronts and fights him.
In Emancipation (S3#20), Lincoln's gambit sends Lash to meet Hive in his place. Lash frees Daisy from Hive's parasites and dies after Hellfire wounds him.

Weaver and Bobbi are already together in Gonzales' leadership on the Iliad in Love in the Time of Hydra (AoS214), where the group decides to have Morse infiltrate Coulson's base. The council stage starts there, not at S2#16.

Gonzales makes a deal for May to join the council, and in the Iliad control room Weaver questions her about Deathlok and Theta Protocol (AoS216). Before that they do not deal with each other directly.
Anatoly's only on-screen meeting with Fisk is In the Blood (DD104), where Fisk beats him to death and decapitates him with a car door. Fandom lists Fisk as his former associate and killer.
Angela only receives Hector's Amulet of Power and White Tiger Suit from McDuffie in Shoot the Moon (DDBA202). In S1 she tries to finish his search for the missing people.

Kim reports to Fisk in DDBA106 and 107, then, as Fisk enacts the Safer Streets Initiative, she takes part in forming Daredevil's Army at Josie's Bar (DDBA109). Fandom lists Fisk among her enemies as former superior.
In Valediction (AC108), Jarvis brings Peggy and Angie to one of Howard Stark's residences and says Stark offers it to them for free for as long as they need. Peggy does not issue the invitation.
Kurt and Dave taser Burch's men and inject them with Uzman's serum, and the 'we traffic in stolen technology' and 'killed many, many people' lines are their confession to police.

After Jiaying is defeated, Weaver works at the Playground under Director Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D., securing alien artifacts like the Monolith with Simmons and Mack (AoS222). Fandom lists Coulson as her Director.
Weaver first appears in Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. in AoS214, where she helps explain the new S.H.I.E.L.D. to Lance Hunter aboard the Iliad.
Triplett pilots the Quinjet that retrieves Simmons and Bobbi as they escape Hydra, cited AoS205. The Ward chase is AoS207.
Trip and Ward fight over Ian Quinn the first time they meet on the Bus, in T.A.H.I.T.I. (AoS114).
Trip trained under Garrett's supervision and first appears on Garrett's team taking custody of Quinn in AoS114.
Trip is the sniper on Creel when Hunter ICERs him and takes his rifle to avenge Hartley, cited AoS202.
After the Hydra uprising, Trip helps Fitz repair the damaged Bus in the Providence section of his biography (the 'Providence' episode, S1#18). The Cuba search is later.
Trip goes with May's team guarding Raina from Whitehall in Vancouver (AoS209) and dies in the Kree temple in AoS210.
Layla and Marc come to Mogart for Senfu's sarcophagus, and Harrow arrives and turns Mogart against them before the fight at his estate (MK103).
The relic Marc and Layla seek at Mogart's estate is Senfu's sarcophagus, not Ammit's ushabti.
The train is raided by Steve, Bucky and Gabe Jones, and Jones captures Zola at gunpoint. Dugan is not on the train, so only crediting his team is accurate.
The High Evolutionary threatens to destroy the Sovereign unless Ayesha brings him Rocket. She is later killed when her ship blows up as Counter-Earth is destroyed, not executed for failing.
